summary: My project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, is an interactive learning experience designed to help students understand what it takes to survive and manage life on the Moon or Mars. Instead of just reading about space missions, students can experience the challenges of running their own space outpost through a fun and educational game. They will learn how to manage essential resources such as oxygen, food, water, power, and radiation protection while making important decisions to keep their astronauts safe. The goal is to make space science more interesting, practical, and enjoyable for young learners. We believe learning becomes more meaningful when students can explore, experiment, and learn from their decisions. Our project brings the excitement of space exploration closer to the next generation of astronauts and scientists.
details: Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational game designed to help students understand the challenges of managing a space outpost on the Moon or Mars. In this game, players take the role of a mission commander and make important decisions to keep their astronauts safe. They must manage four essential resources: oxygen, water, food, and power. Players face different mission situations and choose the best actions to keep their outpost running for seven days. Our project makes space science more interesting by allowing students to learn through interaction rather than just reading information. It encourages critical thinking, problem-solving, decision-making, and resource management. We developed the prototype using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The project aims to make space exploration easier to understand and inspire young learners to become interested in science, technology, and space missions.
